title: An ik-Verb on the Move: utazik

sections.content: utazik ('to travel') ends in -ik, so its first-person singular takes -om, not the regular -ok: utazom, not 'utazok'. Other persons mostly follow the regular pattern.
It's easy to default to -ok out of habit, but any verb ending in -ik in the dictionary form -- dolgozik, lakik, utazik -- needs -om/-em/-öm for 'I'. Say 'utazom', never 'utazok'.
